core_categories: Medical Devices; Capital Equipment; Hospital Consumables; Life Science and Diagnostics
specialty_focus: Getz Healthcare is a specialty medical distributor and market-access partner in the Asia-Pacific region, supplying hospitals, clinics, and laboratories with advanced medical devices, equipment, and consumables. It focuses on therapeutic areas such as cardiovascular, neurology, oncology, and critical care, and provides regulatory support and technical servicing. It does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
